review_scope: Phase 0 governance and strategy only. No asset image, audio, font, data, or caller content was inspected.

checks.observed: All four Git-object bytes at the pinned T2/T3 commits hash to the freeze digests.

checks.name: Effective denominator and batching
checks.observed: The freeze and accepted delta bind 428 paths, 227 groups, five roots, and exactly twelve atomic batches totaling 428 paths and 227 groups; ceilings are 40 paths and 24 groups.

checks.name: Baseline and publication distinction
checks.observed: The freeze and accepted delta correctly distinguish immutable 426/225 source baseline 23bb5ad from publication revision ba95e6f and effective delta revision 65fc00d. Test strategy wording is ambiguous and is recorded below.

checks.name: Theme, external-producer, stop-loss, and no-worktree boundaries
checks.observed: Canonical cute_chibi_v1 and original heroic_stylized_v1 rules, sister-project exclusion, immutable stop losses, and single-checkout/no-worktree policy are present.

checks.name: Role incompatibilities
checks.observed: The root coordinator is forbidden from discovery and candidate-fact authorship, but no qualifying independent discovery-auditor evidence establishes the accepted effective denominator.

checks.name: Focused Red and later-phase outputs
checks.observed: The focused contract correctly Red-ran only for this missing review artifact and no later-phase output artifact exists, but the contract would Green on mere file presence despite the unresolved discovery-proof failure; plan and dispatch state also imply later/undispatched work inconsistently.

high.title: Accepted 428/227 delta lacks qualifying independent discovery-auditor proof
high.evidence: phase0-denominator-drift-report-v1.json remains status=blocked, records 426 paths/225 groups, exceeds its 33,554,432-byte ceiling, and says STOP. The accepted delta binds a candidate and an independent review, but no discovery-auditor receipt/report proves the accepted 428/227 effective denominator within budget. phase0-contract-test.py checks only that the blocked drift-report file exists.
high.impact: Phase 0 could be marked Green while the prerequisite independent discovery gate is failed, violating the role-separation and fail-closed admission rules.
high.required_remediation: Create one fresh, isolated discovery-auditor report and qualifying receipt for the already accepted bounded delta only: verify the exact 428/227 effective denominator, five roots, 12 batches, delta hash chain, and measured usage within the frozen ceiling. Do not rescan or expand scope. Harden phase0-contract-test.py to require that report/receipt pass semantics, exact bindings, and within-ceiling accounting rather than mere file presence; then rerun the focused contract once.

medium.title: Plan reports later phases as in progress before Phase 0 admission
medium.evidence: plan.md marks Phase 1 through Phase 5 producer tasks [~] although no later-phase outputs exist and Phase 0 is not admitted.
medium.impact: The registry misreports progress and weakens the stop-before-content boundary.
medium.required_remediation: Change later-phase tasks to blocked/pending state until the Phase 0 checkpoint is accepted; do not create later outputs.

medium.title: Dispatch and test-strategy state is stale or ambiguous
medium.evidence: DISPATCH.md says no truth-test authoring or adversarial review has been dispatched even though the truth contract/red report and this review exist. test-strategy.md calls the 428-path effective set the exact T2 asset denominator even though T2 is the immutable 426-path base plus accepted T8 delta.
medium.impact: Operators can act on contradictory state or lose the required source-baseline versus effective-denominator distinction.
medium.required_remediation: Update DISPATCH.md to state the actual Phase 0 evidence state without claiming admission, and clarify test-strategy.md that T2 remains 426/225 while T8 consumes the accepted 428/227 effective denominator.

decision.rule: Pass requires zero Critical, High, and Medium findings.
decision.next_action: Perform the single bounded governance remediation specified by P0-H1, P0-M1, and P0-M2; then obtain a fresh independent adversarial review. No asset-content or later-phase work is authorized.
